\[
\text{Total pages}=10+d+240=250+d.

\[
10+8=18
\]

So Denise and Daniel read

\[
\boxed{18\text{ pages altogether yesterday}}
\]

\[

\]

Therefore, Denise read

\[
18-13=\boxed{5\text{ more pages}}
\]
